verdict.rationale: cubic explicitly lets developers connect an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription to power local CLI reviews, which matches 'sign in with existing subscription to use the coding agent.' However, this only applies to local review via CLI, not the full agent/reviewer product, and there's no independent verification of this flow working in practice. Missing for 10: broader applicability beyond CLI reviews, and community/hands-on confirmation of the subscription linking process.
